says: Each plugin that defines hooks must include a `hooks/hooks.json` file
Use `${PLUGIN_ROOT}` in a command to reference the plugin directory.
Shell command to run. goose runs it with `sh -c`.
`allow` (the default) continues the tool call, `block` denies it.
Hook-only Open Plugins can be discovered from `hooks/hooks.json`; if no manifest is present, goose infers the plugin name
Plugins copied manually into `.agents/plugins/` are discovered
